name: Super Programmatic SEO
author: Francisco Padilla

sections.description:
Super Programmatic SEO is a WordPress plugin that uses artificial intelligence to generate high-quality, SEO-optimized articles. It integrates with OpenAI’s ChatGPT API for content generation and Pexels API for professional images, making it perfect for content marketers, SEO agencies, and website owners looking to streamline their content creation process.

FREE Version Features

  • Easy Article Generator: Simple one-click article generation with just a topic/keyword
  • 10 Articles Per Month: Generous free tier for testing and small projects
  • ChatGPT Integration: Uses OpenAI’s ChatGPT API for high-quality content
  • Professional Images: Automatically adds relevant images from Pexels API
  • Company Branding: Incorporates your company details into generated articles
  • SEO Optimization: Built-in SEO best practices and optimization
  • Configuration Status: Built-in verification system to ensure all required APIs are configured
  • WordPress Integration: Seamlessly integrates with WordPress posts and categories

PRO Version Features (Upgrade Available)

  • Unlimited Articles: No monthly limits
  • 11 Writing Styles: Formal, professional, conversational, ironic, extra funny, and more
  • 7 Languages: English, Spanish, Italian, French, Portuguese, German, and Romanian
  • Advanced Article Generator: Customizable content blocks and structure
  • EEAT Optimization: Enhanced E-A-T (Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness) sections
  • FAQ Generation: Automatic FAQ sections for better SEO
  • Campaign Management: Organize and manage content campaigns
  • Priority Support: Direct access to our support team

External APIs Required

  • OpenAI API: For AI content generation (ChatGPT)
  • Pexels API: For high-quality stock images

Security Features

  • Nonce verification for all AJAX requests
  • User capability checks
  • Input sanitization and validation
  • Secure API key storage
  • Proper WordPress coding standards compliance

Perfect For

  • SEO agencies managing multiple clients
  • Content marketers looking to scale content production
  • Blog owners wanting consistent, high-quality content
  • Businesses needing localized content in multiple languages
  • Anyone wanting to leverage AI for content creation

Privacy Policy

This plugin processes data locally on your WordPress installation. API keys are stored securely in your WordPress database. Generated content and user data remain on your server. We recommend reviewing OpenAI’s and Pexels’ privacy policies for their respective services.

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports, please visit our support page at https://superprogrammaticseo.ai/support/

Upgrade to PRO

Unlock the full potential of Super Programmatic SEO:

  • Unlimited Articles: No monthly limits
  • 11 Writing Styles: Choose from formal, professional, conversational, ironic, and more
  • 7 Languages: Generate content in multiple languages
  • Advanced Article Generator: Customizable content blocks and structure
  • Campaign Management: Organize and manage content campaigns
  • Priority Support: Direct access to our support team

Upgrade Now: https://superprogrammaticseo.ai/pricing

Development

Contributing developers can find the plugin source code and contribute at: https://github.com/padbc/super-programmatic-seo
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/super-programmatic-seo directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Navigate to ‘Super Programmatic SEO’ in your WordPress admin menu
  4. Configure your API keys:
    • Get your OpenAI API key from https://platform.openai.com/api-keys
    • Get your Pexels API key from https://www.pexels.com/api/
  5. Add your company details (Company Name and Products/Services are required)
  6. Go to ‘Easy Article’ and start generating your first SEO-optimized article!

FREE Version Limit: You can generate up to 10 articles per month. Upgrade to PRO for unlimited articles and advanced features.
sections.faq:
Do I need API keys to use this plugin?

Yes, you need both OpenAI and Pexels API keys to generate articles and images.

How much do the APIs cost?

  • OpenAI API: Pay-per-use pricing starting at $0.002 per 1K tokens
  • Pexels API: Free with rate limits, paid plans available for higher usage

Can I customize the generated content?

Yes! The plugin offers 11 writing styles, customizable content blocks, and company branding integration.

Is the content SEO-optimized?

Yes! The plugin generates content with proper heading structure, meta descriptions, and E-A-T optimization.

What languages are supported?

The plugin supports English, Spanish, Italian, French, Portuguese, German, and Romanian.

How many articles can I generate with the FREE version?

The FREE version allows you to generate up to 10 articles per month. You can upgrade to PRO for unlimited articles.

What’s the difference between FREE and PRO versions?

FREE version includes Easy Article generator with basic features. PRO version includes unlimited articles, 11 writing styles, 7 languages, advanced article generator, and campaign management.

Can I upgrade to PRO later?

Yes! You can upgrade to PRO at any time by visiting https://superprogrammaticseo.ai/pricing

Do I need the SimpleTOC plugin?

SimpleTOC is optional for the FREE version. It’s recommended for better article structure.
